reason: A /debate command orchestrates pro and con subagents through multiple rounds, optionally adds a neutral judge, persists records locally, and renders the result in a web card.

summaries.zh: 通过 /debate 命令编排正反立场的子代理进行多轮辩论，可选中立评审并在 Web 卡片中展示结果。
summaries.en: Orchestrates multi-round pro and con subagent debates through a /debate command, with optional neutral judging and web card results.

capabilities: Starts position-constrained subagents for alternating debate rounds
Optionally starts a judging subagent to produce a structured verdict
Stores debate records in a plugin-owned JSONL file
Provides RPC read and cancellation methods for a web debate card
